Being a staff engineer is not a purely tech- nical role. Much of the job is about being seen as a leader: writing things down, choosing prob- lems the organization actually needs solved rather than the ones that are most fun, and finding the places where a conversation now saves a quarter of rework later.

As the corpus grows, near-duplicate vectors begin to dominate nearest-neighbor results. Adding a periodic dedupe pass over the embedding space - clustering at cosine similarity above 0.97 and keeping one centroid per cluster - restored recall@10 by 14 points on our internal benchmark.
